property_summary: After calling newEmergencyOracle, the owner of the new EmergencyOracle contract equals the caller (msg.sender) of newEmergencyOracle.
After calling newEmergencyOracle, the new EmergencyOracle contract's owner equals the caller (msg.sender) of newEmergencyOracle.
After calling newEmergencyOracle, the new EmergencyOracle contract's owner equals the address passed to newEmergencyOracle's constructor (msg.sender in reference, jojoTeam in buggy).
After calling newEmergencyOracle, the owner of the newly created EmergencyOracle contract equals the caller of newEmergencyOracle.
After calling newEmergencyOracle, the new EmergencyOracle contract's owner is not the jojoTeam address (unless msg.sender equals jojoTeam).
After calling newEmergencyOracle, the newly created EmergencyOracle's price equals 0 and its turnOn is false.
After a call to newEmergencyOracle, the caller can still call newEmergencyOracle again.
After calling newEmergencyOracle, the new oracle's owner is the caller (msg.sender).
After calling newEmergencyOracle, the new oracle's description matches the input parameter.
After calling newEmergencyOracle with a given description, the newly created EmergencyOracle's description matches the input.
